about: The AE auto-shotgun pack (folder auto_shotgun): ZTeam's modern combat shotgun (the ZTeam tag pack's shotgun/h3_hunter: its model, worn in first and third person as ZTeam's weapon wears it, shaders, bitmaps, first-person animations and HUD; shotgun/h3's collision and reload and melee sounds, shotgun/h2's shot) as an Xbox weapon tuned as AE's semi-automatic close-range shotgun; everything the stock shotgun has is the map's. The action is a semi-automatic's: the first-person animations are ours, made from ZTeam's by auto_shotgun_anims.py (a shot never works the forend; the forend is worked once, at the end of a reload, by the exit animation, whichever exit the engine picks, and the draw racks it once, ZTeam's ready with its sound, as a semi-automatic is charged; the reload's enter and shell loop play about a fifth faster; the idle posing is ZTeam's one that leaves the forend alone; the stroke sounds of the shot and the posing are taken off), and the third-person animation graph (a forend stroke) is left out. The role is the latest-gen sandbox's semi-automatic close-range shotgun, re-expressed for AE (its shield and body of 140 + 70, ours 75 + 75; a world unit taken as a world unit): there, 12 pellets of 10 inside 4 units falling to 4 past 9, 15 units of range, a 2-shot kill up close, 3 shots strip and 5 kill at the far edge, about 1.56 shots a second. Here: 12 pellets of 7.2 (86.4 a shot: 2 shots kill a full player, 1 never does) at full speed, 2.9 once slowed (34.8 a shot: 3 strip the 75 shield, 5 kill, 4 = 139.2 do not), x1.0 on shield and body, no headshots. The falloff is the round's speed (CE scales a hit's damage between its two bounds by the speed it hits at): 750 units a second slowing to 90 within its first tick, over the air damage range's 8-unit span (the lower bound 25, above the first tick's 25 units, only starts the slowing at once): full damage inside about 4 units, the lower bound past about 9.3, the pellets gone at 15. 5 degrees of pellet spread (the stock shotgun's 10), so the full-damage zone is reached; no bloom. 1.75 shots a second (0.57 s a shot: a 2-shot kill in 0.57 s, the semi-automatic fire animation 0.47 s); 6 shells loaded one at a time (the first 0.5 s, then 0.43 s each, 2.67 s for all 6 before the exit's one stroke: the engine times each shell by the enter and loop animations, ours made from ZTeam's 0.63 s and 0.53 s; the tag's reload time is set to the loop's 0.433 to agree), 12 to start and 24 in reserve. Aim assist 4 degrees to 10 units, magnetism 9 degrees to 12 units (the stock shotgun's 6 to 15 and 12 to 15). Against the stock shotgun (15 pellets of 18-25 with shields at x0.5, a one-shot kill up close, 1 shot a second, 12 shells, 10 degrees): never a one-shot, a tighter pattern, a faster follow-up. make_pack.py runs it; the locations of the zip, the stock map and the programs are given on its command line (--zip).

stock_derived.ae\\packs\\auto_shotgun\\zteam\\objects\: the stock shotgun's pellet (projectile and damage effect: impacts, materials) with our own speed, falloff, damage, shield factor and range
the stock shotgun's firing effect (flash, smoke, casing) with ZTeam's shotgun shot
the stock shotgun's firing kick (a damage effect) with our own rumble on both motors

tools.ffmpeg: n9.0.2 (decodes the Ogg Vorbis permutations to 16-bit PCM)
tools.art: Python 3.14 with Pillow 12.2.0 and numpy 2.4.4 drew the art pinned below (each by its decoded pixels, mode and size, not by its file)

steps.why: the Xbox model format; ZTeam's weapon wears this one model in first and third person (its nodes are the gun's own, its origin the gun's)

the third-person model: ZTeam's same model under its own tag (ZTeam's weapon wears its one model in both views; its geometry is the gun alone, on the gun's own nodes), so that the weapon's world and first-person models are two tags, as every pack's are
the multipurpose map's channels from Halo PC's order to the Xbox's

the semi-automatic first-person animations (auto_shotgun_anims.py, from ZTeam's): no forend stroke on a shot, one rack on the draw (ZTeam's ready), one stroke at the end of every reload; the reload's enter and shell loop about a fifth faster (15 and 13 frames); the stroke sounds of the shot and the forend-check posing taken off

the auto-shotgun's pellet: the stock shotgun pellet's damage effect (impacts, materials) at our numbers: 7.2 at full speed, 2.9 once slowed (the lower bound is the damage at the final speed), x1.0 on a Spartan's shield and body (the stock pellet's shield factor is 0.5): 12 pellets make 86.4 a shot up close (2 kill a full 150, 1 never does) and 34.8 at range (3 strip the 75 shield, 5 kill, 4 do not)

the auto-shotgun's pellet: the stock shotgun pellet (impacts) carrying our damage effect, 750 units a second (25 a tick) slowing to 90 (3 a tick) inside its first tick over the air damage range's 8-unit span (the lower bound 25 starts the slowing at once): full damage inside about 4 units, the lower bound past about 9.3 (the SMG round's slowing, measured on the box, and the same arithmetic); gone at 15 units
the firing effect: the stock shotgun's (its flash, smoke and the casing thrown on the shot, as a semi-automatic ejects) with ZTeam's shotgun shot in place of the stock one in both of its sound events

haptics (the done checklist's point 14): the stock shotgun's firing kick, made again under the pack's name with a shorter thump on both motors each shot (the stock one's 0.3 s high motor would run into the next shot at 1.75 a second)

the auto-shotgun's own HUD: ZTeam's shotgun HUD as released (its 6-shell meter, its round shotgun reticle and the weapon's picture), its rounds panel the map's stock one in place of ZTeam's chain of panels, whose last draws a full-screen visor frame over the game's own HUD; the source's own panel is out (its static elements and meter): no panel of the pack's draws under the classic HUD style
the swap and pickup prompts' picture: ZTeam's own picture of the shotgun (its HUD's weapon picture), resampled onto a one-sprite sheet by source_icon.py; nothing drawn
the donor map only: HUD globals naming the prompts' picture so the donor holds it (the pack takes it by its root)

the Xbox models (ZTeam's one model, under a third-person and a first-person tag); no third-person animation graph (ZTeam's names shotgun/h3's, a forend stroke on another node set); ZTeam's flashlight (a light and its light volume) left out; everything the map's stock shotgun has (muzzle flash, materials, drop sound, melee, ammo pickup sound and message indices, empty click) is the map's; the firing kick is the stock shotgun's with our rumble; our own numbers (the about): 6 shells loaded one at a time (the reload time the shell loop's 13 frames, which the engine times a shell by), 12 to start, 24 in reserve, 1.75 shots a second, 12 pellets in 5 degrees, no bloom, aim assist 4 degrees to 10 units, magnetism 9 to 12

expected.about: the first build of the recipe (2026-11-04, revision 1); re-pinned 2026-11-04 for the owner's answers (one rack on the draw, the reload about a fifth faster) and its credits text: built twice (a, b) from a clean checkout, byte-identical, then verified; re-pinned for the pack's HUD without the source's own panel (nothing of the pack's draws under the classic HUD style); a pack built twice from the recipe was the same
